channel.title: Shaurya · Log
channel.description: Experimental engineering notes on AI, machine learning, graphics, programming, computation, and the things I build to understand how they work.

item.title: Twenty-three people, 256 bits
item.description: A purely combinatorial fact about shared birthdays forces a real engineering decision made decades later, why cryptographic hashes are 256 bits, not 128.

item.title: Where Does Computation End?
item.description: A journey from the Halting Problem and Turing machines to hypercomputation, physical computation, and the question of whether reality can compute beyond Turing.

item.title: A renderer that keeps notes on itself
item.description: A Mandelbrot renderer that doesn't cache to disk or a database - it rewrites its own source file to remember what it's already drawn.

item.title: Never repeating, never leaving
item.description: Four chaotic systems, one Python framework, and the one that refused to fit it.

item.title: Marching with rays
item.description: Build a raymarcher/raytracer with anti-aliasing, from scratch, within 168 lines of Java.

item.title: grok.....grok ?
item.description: What happens when you push a model past generalization? Does it know the rule, or just the data?
